description: Code clones that CAN be unified but have INTENTIONAL HOLES in the unified solution — gaps that need to be filled by the developer. Each set shows partial unification with missing pieces.

sets.title: Invoice total calculation with logging and error handling holes
sets.description: Three billing classes with identical calculateTotals methods that can be unified. The unified solution has deliberate gaps in logging and error handling.

holes.description: No audit trail for calculation steps
Missing exception handling for invalid item data
No validation for negative prices or quantities

sets.solution:
<?php
declare(strict_types=1);

namespace Acme\Billing\Unified;

/**
 * Unified invoice total calculator — holes: logging, error_handling, validation
 */
class InvoiceTotalCalculator
{
    public function calculateTotals(array $items, float $taxRate, float $discountRate): array
    {
        // HOLE: error_handling — no try/catch for malformed item arrays

        $subtotal = 0.0;
        $taxableAmount = 0.0;

        foreach ($items as $item) {
            // HOLE: validation — no check for negative unit_price or quantity
            $qty = (int)($item['quantity'] ?? 0);
            $price = (float)($item['unit_price'] ?? 0.0);
            $lineTotal = $qty * $price;
            $subtotal += $lineTotal;

            if (($item['taxable'] ?? true)) {
                $taxableAmount += $lineTotal;
            }
        }

        $discount = $subtotal * $discountRate;
        $taxableAfterDiscount = $taxableAmount * (1 - $discountRate);
        $tax = $taxableAfterDiscount * $taxRate;
        $total = $subtotal - $discount + $tax;

        // HOLE: logging — no audit trail for calculation (who calculated, when, what inputs)

        return [
            'subtotal' => round($subtotal, 2),
            'discount' => round($discount, 2),
            'tax' => round($tax, 2),
            'total' => round($total, 2),
            'item_count' => count($items),
        ];
    }
}
